mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exams (user_id, title, description, status, source_type, source_refs, question_count, linked_plan_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{status}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceRefs}::jsonb, #{questionCount}, #{linkedPlanId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, description, status, source_type, source_refs, question_count, linked_plan_id, created_at FROM exams WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND linked_plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE exams SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{examId}
UPDATE exams SET linked_plan_id = #{linkedPlanId} WHERE id = #{examId} AND linked_plan_id IS NULL
